title: Up and Coming Podcast
author: League of Filmmakers
description:
A Podcast for the Next Generation of Filmmakers


Breaking into the film industry isn’t just about talent — it’s about timing, access, and learning how to move before anyone knows your name. In an industry obsessed with finished success, the early chapters often go undocumented.


Up & Coming is a podcast for new and established filmmakers of all kinds to talk about the beginning of that climb.


Produced by Cinematography For Actors, this series spotlights voices across directing, writing, cinematography, producing, acting, and beyond — the people building careers in real time, learning by doing, and figuring it out without a safety net.


Each episode focuses on the honest, in-between moments: first festivals, early funding wins (and losses), imposter syndrome, creative pivots, and the practical decisions that can shape a career long before the spotlight arrives. Guests don’t just speak from hindsight — they speak from the middle of it.


Up & Coming exists to document momentum, not mastery.


To remind filmmakers that the path forward isn’t linear — and that being “up and coming” is not a waiting room, but a phase worth paying attention to.

Because every filmmaker you admire was once right here.

title: After the Flash
author: Neal
description:
Every world changing technology has a moment right after it works. The excitement fades, and the harder questions show up. Should we have built it? Who gets to decide? And what does it mean for our families?


After the Flash is a show about those questions, from a mid 40s dad who works full time, builds his own software on the side, and has been into tech his whole life. Some weeks it starts with a movie like Oppenheimer or Interstellar. Some weeks it’s a true story or something straight out of the headlines: AI, VR, the tech our kids are growing up with, and the stuff quietly changing how we all live.


Every episode, Neal tells you exactly where he stands and why. No hype, just one dad trying to keep up and think it through out loud. New episodes every two weeks.

author: Timothy Cunningham
description:
The Symaiosis Institute equips fiduciaries at public pensions, endowments, and foundations with research and frameworks to govern AI's consequences for portfolios, labor markets, and beneficiaries. Nonpartisan, non-commercial, practitioner-focused.
Hosted by Timothy Cunningham, the show brings together limited partners, general partners, pension and endowment leaders, trustees, investment professionals, academics, researchers, and operators to examine AI exposure across private equity, venture capital, and their portfolio companies.
Each episode addresses the questions long-horizon asset owners need to ask: How is AI affecting enterprise value, underwriting, workforce transformation, labor-market risk, competitive positioning, portfolio monitoring, and investment governance?
From AI due diligence and LP-GP dialogue to responsible deployment and beneficiary outcomes, TIM TALKS: Symaiosis offers practical, nonpartisan analysis for CIOs, investment committees, and private-market participants.

title: After the Porch Light

description:
Some stories don’t end when the lights go out.
Deep in the quiet of South Carolina, when the day is done and the porch light goes dark, the stories begin.
Welcome to After the Porch Light, a husband-and-wife true crime podcast where Southern roots meet dark curiosity.
She’s a little witchy, a little alternative, and endlessly curious. He’s blue-collar, levelheaded, and never afraid to ask the questions everyone else is thinking.
Together, we step into the unsettling world of true crime, unraveling disappearances, murders, unanswered questions, and the stories that refuse to stay buried.
Behind every headline is a real person. A family. A life that mattered. And while the details may be disturbing, the people at the center of these stories deserve to be remembered.
Pull up a chair. The porch light’s off. Let’s get into it.
🎧 LISTEN, FOLLOW & CONNECT

https://beacons.ai/atpl_podcast

If you enjoy listening, please follow or subscribe, leave us a five-star rating, and write a review. Every rating, review, and share helps our little corner of the true crime world grow and brings these stories to more listeners.
⚠️ CONTENT DISCLAIMER
After the Porch Light discusses real criminal cases and may contain descriptions of violence, death, abuse, and other disturbing subject matter. Listener discretion is advised.

We strive for accuracy and distinguish established facts from allegations, theories, and personal opinions. All individuals are presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.
Our intention is never to sensationalize tragedy, but to approach these stories with curiosity, compassion, and respect for victims and their loved ones.

description: Reliable diagnostics make a difference during the busiest parts of winter and summer, when appointment windows can fill quickly across Blairs and surrounding areas. For heat pump repair, technicians often examine the defrost cycle, check outdoor fan operation, test reversing valves, and confirm that auxiliary heat strips engage only when needed. Safety steps are just as important on gas equipment; during furnace repair, a typical visit may include checking ignition systems, cleaning flame sensors, confirming proper venting, and measuring carbon monoxide to verify safe operation. If airflow is limited, air duct cleaning or sealing options may be discussed to help the system move air efficiently. No perfect answers. No instructions on how to live.
Just stories, questions and different ways of looking at life.
❤️ What I would keep.
Thank you for having a think with me.

title: The Ricardo Gonzalez Show
author: Ricardo F. Gonzalez
description: It's been 15 years since we last heard from Ricardo. Now he's back! Join Ricardo and Annique as they come back to the podcasting world and the world in general! It's been 15 years, but they are still as angry, funnier and spicier than ever!

title: Latte & Life
author: By Toast Social
description:
Sometimes the most powerful conversations don’t happen in planned interviews or big moments. They happen quietly, over coffee, over brunch, when people slow down and the conversation moves beyond the usual small talk. 
That’s the idea behind Latte & Life. 
It’s a podcast about real people and the stories that shaped them. The moments they’re proud of, the things they’ve overcome, and the experiences that changed the direction of their lives. The kind of conversations that happen naturally when someone feels comfortable enough to speak honestly.

title: UNAPOLOGETIC with Shukri Wrights
author: Shukri Wrights
description: Unapologetic with Shukri Wrights is a national YouTube Show & podcast hosted by Sports Radio Host & Producer Shukri Wrights of 97.5 The Fanatic discussing the latest national sports headlines with unapologetic strong opinions and takes.

title: Soul Path Insights
author: Amelie Chambord
description:
Life rarely unfolds as planned. Sometimes we’re growing. Sometimes we’re grieving. Sometimes we’re praying for direction while trying to get through Tuesday.


Welcome to Soul Path Insights, a podcast where faith meets everyday life. I’m Amélie Chambord, a writer sharing personal stories, biblical encouragement, and honest reflections on trusting God, navigating relationships, starting over, and finding purpose as we grow older.


These conversations begin with lived experience—including the uncomfortable moments I’m still learning from. Expect thoughtful questions, a little humor, and room to admit that loving God doesn’t mean we have everything figured out.


My hope is that you leave each episode feeling less alone, encouraged in your faith, and ready to take one meaningful step forward.


Come as you are. Let’s grow from here.

title: The Stronger Side
author: Alex john
description: The Stronger Side is a fitness podcast about building strength, staying active, and making healthier choices in everyday life. Each episode explores simple ways to improve your routine, develop better habits, and stay motivated without putting unnecessary pressure on yourself. From getting started with exercise to finding balance between fitness and daily responsibilities, this podcast keeps things practical, honest, and easy to understand. You do not need to be an athlete or have a perfect routine to make progress. Whether you are taking your first steps toward a healthier lifestyle or working to stay consistent, The Stronger Side is here to help you move forward one day at a time.

title: Karlosophies and the Creative Resistance
author: Karly Nimmo
description:
Karly Nimmo explores creative resistance from two very different angles: the internal, and the external.
The external form being: human creativity as a form of systemic and political resistance...  How can we reclaim creative agency is this age of AI? 
And the internal: Working through our own own personal creative resistance. How do we we move through our own self doubt, and the creative blocks that stop us from expressing ourselves.

title: Promoting Equitable Intervention and Special Education Referral for ELLs
author: Tyra A Hicks
description: Discussing essential information about intervention, collaboration, and special education referrals when we’re supporting bilingual and English learner students.

title: Sport! the podcast
author: johnny
description: Sport! the podcast is a podcast about sports. we’re talking about more than just current sport events, or historical events. We get a bit nerdier and dive into weird rules, outrageous personalities, and so much more.

title: Parsha-ly Crazy
author: Matthew Ponak, Joel Goldstein & Rebecca Croog
description:
Three friends. One Torah portion. A conversation that rarely goes according to plan.
Parsha-ly Crazy brings Rabbi Joel Goldstein, Dr. Rebecca Croog, and Rabbi Matthew Ponak together for lively conversations about the weekly Torah portion. Drawing on Jewish tradition, scholarship, mysticism, lived experience, and three very different perspectives, they follow the Torah wherever it takes them.
Expect ancient texts, big questions, disagreement, unexpected connections, terrible puns, occasional irreverence, and plenty of laughter. The conversation is intellectual without being stuffy, spiritual without taking itself too seriously, and accessible whether you’ve been studying Torah for decades or are just curious about what all the fuss is about.
*Rabbi Joel Goldstein* is a rabbi, teacher, and scholar with a particular love of Talmud, halakhah, and the classical Jewish tradition.
*Dr. Rebecca Croog* brings a thoughtful, dynamic perspective grounded in Jewish communal life, social responsibility, and the questions that arise when ancient texts meet the real world.
*Rabbi Matthew Ponak* is a teacher of Jewish mysticism, spiritual counselor, and author of Embodied Kabbalah , with a particular interest in Kabbalah, Hasidism, and the historical development of Jewish tradition.

Through honest solo conversations and inspiring women sharing their stories, we’ll explore confidence, self-worth, purpose, passion, career, business, mentorship, and everything in between. My goal? To help you see yourself more clearly, get intentional about what you want, and build the courage to go after it.

The First to Go! with L.A. Floyd
A horror comedy podcast hosted and produced by L.A. Floyd. Each episode, a new guest joins Floyd to dive into a horror movie, play games like "Plot or Not," and give shout-outs. Our guests are artists, musicians, and awesome people who love to hang out.
Expect honest takes, big laughs, and plenty of horror love, from cult classics to modern scares to movies so bad they're good.
New guests. New nightmares. New movies.
Watch with the crew and you just might be the first to go.

title: Independent Not Alone
author: Ardita Kurtaj
description:
Honest conversations for independent business owners who do it all...alone.
Running an independent business can feel like carrying the whole world on your shoulders. You’re the owner, manager, HR, marketing, therapist, problem-solver and cleaner; often with no big budget, no safety net, and not nearly enough support.
Hosted by hospitality founder and coach Ardita Kurtaj, this podcast is your honest, unfiltered space to learn how to lead yourself, your team and your business when you’re tired, short-staffed and still expected to smile.

description: Join us as we discuss the journey of eating sustainably and lessening the use of plastics in food preparation and storage.  We’ll discuss swapping out ultra-processed foods in your favorite episodes, and alternatives to plastic in how we eat and prepare our favorite dishes.

author: Lilly Ryan
description: An audio series exploring the intersection of technology, culture, and what it means to be human in the so-called “intelligence age”.

title: Silent Shifts
author: Nova Audio
description:
What if the moment that changed your life didn’t feel big at the time? What if it was something small - easy to miss, easy to forget - until suddenly it wasn’t?
Silent Shifts is a collection of immersive audio stories, each told by a different character looking at the instant everything quietly tilted. 
Darkly comic, tragically poignant, and wonderfully uplifting, capturing the messy truth of how change really feels.

title: Void of Nothing

description: Join us as we discuss the improbable and the impossible. Take a walk through the minds of those who think not just outside of the box, but beyond the concept of dimensional space itself.

title: Ride To Pluto Radio
author: Eden
description: Ride to Pluto is not only a Strava club, it’s a community. This podcast talks about everything, weekly rides, mileage goals, challenges, and the stories behind the cyclists who make the journey fun. If you ride, or you are just here for vibes, your in the right place!

title: Clock It
author: The Facial Femmes
description:
Clock It! Is a podcast hosted by best friends Oakland and Meredith, also known as The Facial Femmes. We dive into the transgender experience with honest, unfiltered conversations about identity, culture, and life today. From everyday challenges to the complexities of being "clocked," we explore what it truly means to be trans.
Every listen and share directly helps fundraise for our upcoming gender-affirming surgeries. Thank you for supporting the dolls and joining our community!

title: The Business Blender: Business Strategy for Women Over 40
author: The Business Blender
description:
The Business Blender is a practical business podcast for women over 40 building solo businesses who are tired of piecing everything together themselves.


Hosted by Heidi Rasmussen Totten and Lori Hildebrand Walker, the show covers the real work of building a business that is clear, profitable, organized, and sustainable. That includes business strategy, offers, messaging, marketing, sales, systems, technology, AI, visibility, productivity, client experience, and growth.


This is not a hype podcast.


We are not here to tell you every idea is brilliant, push you into hustle mode, or hand you another generic checklist without context. We are here to help you make better decisions about what deserves your focus, what needs to change, what systems are missing, and what will actually move your business forward.


If you are a Gen X woman, midlife entrepreneur, coach, consultant, service provider, creator, or experienced professional trying to turn what you know into a stronger business, you are in the right place.

Expect practical conversations, clear business thinking, useful frameworks, honest opinions, and strategies you can actually implement.


Build a business that works for your life, not the other way around.

Learn more at TheBusinessBlender.com.

title: The Luxury Hour: Premium Human Frameworks for Business
author: Sarah Auda, M.A., M.T.S.
description:
The core of luxury is human attention — and here’s what businesses need to know about it.

The Luxury Hour Podcast explores what the world’s most exceptional brands and experiences can teach businesses about exceptional thoughtfulness and design.

Hosted by expert strategist Sarah Auda, each episode uncovers the principles behind extraordinary service and translates them into premium human frameworks that any business can apply. True luxury isn’t about excess. It’s about quality and intention in every detail and every relationship.

TheLuxuryHour.com

Owned and operated by ThreeBeatsConsulting.com.

title: Continence Chat
author: TZMO USA
description: SENI is proud to present "Continence Chat" - A bi-monthly conversation about incontinence. Enjoy interviews with a variety of experts, caregivers, and business owners sharing stories about this often difficult subject matter in a safe, casual, and uplifting environment. Continence Chat strives to make an uncomfortable conversation comfortable again. Let's talk about it!

Witty Historian is a sleep-focused history podcast featuring calm, immersive storytelling designed to help you fall asleep.
Each episode explores unusual and often unsettling historical topics — including drug history, human behavior, and forgotten events — told in a slow, steady voice for relaxation and sleep.
Perfect for listeners looking for sleep stories, relaxing podcasts, or quiet background narration to unwind at night.

title: Nonprofit Fundraising with Courtney Henry
author: Courtney
description:
Nonprofits don’t need more fundraising activity. They need fundraising that actually funds the work.


Nonprofit Fundraising with Courtney henry is for nonprofit leaders who are responsible for raising the funding their organisation needs, without unlimited time, people or resources to do it.


Hosted by Courtney Henry, fundraising strategist and founder of Henry Consulting Co, the podcast takes a practical look at what actually goes into raising money for nonprofit organisations.


We’ll talk fundraising strategy, philanthropy, grants, donors, boards, fundraising teams, compelling funding opportunities, donor relationships, making the ask and the internal roadblocks that can make raising money harder than it needs to be.


You’ll hear practical advice, real fundraising stories and lessons from Courtney’s experience helping raise more than $80 million, from major capital campaigns to multimillion-dollar gifts.


Because the goal isn’t to do more fundraising.


It’s to raise the funding your organisation needs.

title: Off the Cusp- Chatter for the Noncompliant
author: Dr. Sarah Heeter and Dr. Paul Kourtsounis
description:
Two dentists. One podcast. Zero filter.
Join Dr. Paul Kourtsounis and Dr. Sarah Heeter as they explore unconventional paths in dentistry and beyond. From challenging the status quo and redefining success to candid conversations with people who've taken the road less traveled, nothing is off-limits. Expect humor, sarcasm, unfiltered opinions, and stories that prove there's no one-size-fits-all approach to building a career—or a life. Think happy hour with interesting people who never quite followed the rules.
Compliance is optional.

title: The History Of Us
author: Willie D.Bestman
description: A historical podcast that spans the length of the human narrative. Journey from West to East and across millennia to discover how fragile bands of hunter-gatherers became a global civilization.

title: Bluefors Podcast
author: Bluefors
description:
Bluefors Podcast shares conversations about cryogenics, quantum technology, scientific research and the people working in these fields.
Through three different series, you'll get to know the people behind Bluefors in Behind the Cold, explore the science, engineering and innovations behind our technologies with Bluefors experts in Cool Insights, and hear from researchers and industry experts around the world about the latest developments, how Bluefors technologies support their work and what could come next in Beyond Absolute Zero.
Follow for new episodes and stay connected at bluefors.com.

title: Self Canceling Podcast
author: MOShow Jay
description: Self Canceling Pod is exactly what it's title says.   We did a podcast from 2011 - 2018 called The Mental Overload Show and we will be summarizing and exploring where we went wrong, episode by episode.    Also will be doing current thoughts and streams of consciousness. Goal is to right our wrongs, make some new content, and hopefully build a community of like minded decent people with dark senses of humor.    If you're easily offended GO AWAY!

title: Derby Revolution
author: Derby Revolution
description:
The story of roller derby in Europe, told by the people who built it. 🛼
Derby Revolution is a podcast about how roller derby took off across Europe and the UK, from the first leagues and the pioneers behind them to the teams making history today. We start with the road to the first WFTDA Global Championships on European soil in Malmö, then dig deeper into how it all began.
Expect plenty of derby history, researched with care and told with love for the sport.
Hosted by Miyagi.

title: Re-Embracing Me: Inside the Life of a Spiritual Creative
author: Tegan Louise | ART from SPIRIT
description:
Are you navigating change, feeling disconnected from yourself, wanting to hear your inner voice, or wondering what comes next?
Join Tegan Louise for Re-Embracing Me, where creativity, spirituality & real life meet. Through stories, reflections and experiences from her journey, each episode invites your own self-discovery: to reconnect with yourself, trust your inner wisdom & explore what feels true for you.
Whether spirituality is already part of your life or you are curious, follow the podcast & journey alongside her as you make space for clarity, possibility & your inner light to shine.

title: Permission to Speak
author: Genesis Cordoba
description:
Permission to speak is a space for the conversations we think about, whisper about, argue about, heal through--and sometimes never say out loud.
Hosted by Genesis, this podcast explores womanhood, relationships,identity, culture, healing, ambition,
Sex, friendship, family, and beautifully complicated experiences that shape who we become.
You don't have to agree to belong in this conversation. No perfect answers. No pretending to have it all figured . Just honest conversations, real perspectives, and room to say the things that deserve to be said. 
The Mic is on, the floor is ours.

As a Marriage and Family Therapist specializing in couples and sexuality, I will also sometimes discuss adjacent topics such as attachment, dating, couples goals, communication, sex addiction and relational dynamics.

description: ‘Culture Apothecary with Alex Clark’ is a health and wellness podcast where each guest provides their own remedy to heal a sick culture - physically, emotionally, and spiritually. Apothecaries were the place where people would go for natural remedies, and Alex is restoring this concept by inviting expert guests every Monday and Thursday night at 6pm PST/9pm EST to share raw, unpasteurized truths!

title: Tales from the Salish Sea
author: Salish Sea Tales
description: Short stories from the islands and waters of the Pacific Northwest, for the people who live here, visit here, or simply love a good story. Discover fiction, stories from history, and island life, alongside community organizations caring for the Salish Sea. Read more or share a story at https://salishseatales.com. Episodes feature AI-generated host and narrator voices.

title: Classic Reads ASMR
author: Laine V. Rose
description:
Welcome to Classic Reads ASMR, your cozy, late-night sanctuary for timeless literature and peaceful relaxation.
Immerse yourself in gentle, soft-spoken readings of classic stories, historical tales, and beloved books. Designed to help you unwind, quiet a busy mind, reduce stress, or ease into a deep, restful night’s sleep, every episode offers a calm, intimate reading experience paired with smooth, crisp audio.
Grab your favorite blanket, settle in, and let the beauty of classic literature lull you to sleep. New episodes drop regularly—hit follow to never miss a chapter!

title: Psychopedia: True Crime & Criminal Psychology
author: vczx
description: Psychopedia is a captivating true crime podcast hosted by Investigator Slater, where she passionately takes you deep into the darkest recesses of the human psyche each week. A professional investigator by day, Slater uses her investigative expertise to uncover the chilling, hidden details behind each true crime case presented. Even if you think you’ve heard about a particular case before, prepare for a fresh, eye-opening perspective that dives deeper into the facts, psychology, criminology, and the dark truths you never knew.  Every episode is presented with the utmost respect for the victims, while keeping you hooked with pop quizzes designed to engage and entertain (and give you a glimpse into Slater's own twisted mind). Prepare for a truly immersive experience—because this is true crime like you've never heard it before.Instagram + TikTok: @psychopediapod @investigatorslater. A podcast in partnership with Podcast Nation.266078

title: Midnight Radio
author: iHeartPodcasts
description:
Starring five-time Academy Award®-nomineeEthan Hawke as “The Radio Man,” MIDNIGHT RADIO is a new, fantastical horror podcast.  
 
Told in real-time through the lens of a cult-favorite late-night AM radio show, the series follows a host (played by Ethan) whose eerie, conspiracy-themed call-in program takes a chilling turn. One night, he receives a call from a man claiming to be part of a secret U.S. space mission lost to history—just the first thread in a sprawling web of government cover-ups, interdimensional breaches, and psychological warfare.
 
As the broadcast unfolds, strange signals hidden in the radio static reveal themselves. With each episode building on the last, one question grows more urgent—who, or what, is really on the other end of the line? And what do they want?
 
Created and co-written by Scott Derrickson and C. Robert Cargill and produced by Under The Influence Productions (founded by Ethan Hawke and his wife, Ryan Hawke), Crooked Highway and Mickey Schiff in collaboration with iHeartPodcasts.

title: The Guardrails Podcast
author: Michael Stevens and Blaise Schroeder
description:
Good news: you got the job. Bad news: school left out half the syllabus. How do you handle a difficult conversation? Find a mentor? Own a mistake? Figure out what everyone else seems to know already? On The Guardrails Podcast™, Blaise Schroeder (the old guard), and Michael Stevens (the new guard), talk honestly about the messy, human side of professional life. They’ve made the mistakes and learned the hard lessons. Take what helps, challenge what doesn’t, and know you’re not the only one figuring it out as you go.

On The Guardrails Podcast, Blaise Schroeder (the old guard) and Michael Stevens (the new guard) will lead us through these workplace conversations. Once a month, they’ll bring different perspectives from career paths, share lessons learned the hard way, and welcome guests with stories of their own.

title: Under Cover of Knight
author: bdsfr
description:
In 1996, Sue Knight was found dead in her Athens, TX, home. Her will named a loose acquaintance as the executor of her estate, but after an alleged phone call from the CIA and a dire warning from the local sheriff, the executor stopped asking questions. More than 25 years later, Sue’s memory haunts the town of Athens and the people who knew her. Who was Sue, really? Why did this English expat settle in small-town Texas? And could she still be alive?
Under Cover of Knight is an Apple Original podcast, produced by Spoke Media and Castleview Productions. Listen and follow on Apple Podcasts.apple.co/UnderCover

title: In Her Defence: Breach of Trust
author: bvcg
description: What happens when one of the “good guys” turns out to be a bad guy?   The highly-acclaimed true crime podcast series In Her Defence returns with In Her Defence: Breach of Trust. This seven-episode season explores the case of Sgt. Robert Semenchuck, a Regina police officer who preyed on hundreds of vulnerable women using information from police databases.  Some of those women risked it all to expose him, and hold him accountable. But would the system punish one of its own?   Hosted by award-winning crime reporter Jana G. Pruden, and based on more than 50 hours of exclusive interviews with dozens of women, police officers, lawyers and legal experts, In Her Defence: Breach of Trust reveals serious gaps in the way law enforcement agencies in Canada are policing themselves, and the serious harm women are suffering as a result.  Launching September 8, 2026.  Follow In Her Defence now, so you don’t miss an episode.

title: Last Seen Alive

description: Last Seen Alive is a podcast focused on little-known, unsolved homicide and missing persons cases, all potentially just one tip away from an investigative breakthrough. We're on a mission to give these cases the public attention and thoughtful storytelling they deserve, so join us as we explore the compelling unsolved cases you've never heard of every week.  Researched, written and hosted by Crime Analyst Leah Owens. Co-hosted by Scott Owens.  Last Seen Alive is an original Studio 222 production.

author: Kylie Lately
description: For the woman who is literally in the middle of it all - she's navigating midlife and the identity shifts that come along with it. Plus the balance of raising kids, health, happiness, neurodivergence and love in all of its forms. From romantic love to friendships, family and career. With honest reflections and thoughtful conversations on love, identity and midlife. Kylie uses her training in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy to approach the topics that matter during this stage of life. This podcast was formerly known as Almost Forty. Subscribe to Almost Confidential for access to extra weekly episodes - These are the BTS eps with details that never make it to the main feed. Listen here https://apple.co/iam

title: The One Minute Mile
author: OneMinuteMile
description:
The One-Minute Mile is a comedy panel game where each panelist is given a random subject on which to speak for a minute—but without hesitation, deviation, or repetition. It’s not easy, but you can have a lot of fun trying, as our panelists prove every week!

Based on the BBC panel game Just a Minute®, this podcast is an homage to that wonderful program, its creator Ian Messiter, its longtime chair Nicholas Parsons, and the talented team that carries on that glorious tradition.

None of the participants in The One-Minute Mile speak in any official capacity. All opinions expressed are their own.
We always strive to be 100% fact-free.

description: For thirty years, Rush Propst has been one of the most successful — and most talked-about — coaches in high school football: eight state championships, over 300 wins, a national title, and the program MTV made famous in Two-A-Days. Everybody knows where he's been. Win The Room is about the rest of the story. Each week, Coach Propst sits down to tell the truth about a career the cameras never fully captured — the dynasties, the controversies he owns, the locker rooms, the lessons — and to break down the game as only he can: quarterbacks, leadership, recruiting, and what's really changed between

description: Everyone is overcoming something. Overcoming to Live Well features honest conversations about adversity, transformation, and finding a better way forward. title: Lux Radio Theatre
author: Gold World Entertainment
description:
Lux…presents Hollywood!
”These words introduced broadcast radio’s biggest and most important dramatic program. For two decades, The Lux Radio Theater presented radio versions of movie attractions, current or coming, while the biggest names in cinema played the leading roles.The Lux Radio Theater debuted in 1934, dramatizing Broadway plays from New York. In an effort to improve ratings, the show moved West in June 1936 to capitalize on Hollywood talent and popular movie fare.Lux’s extravagant productions were a huge success. Renowned director Cecil B. DeMille—whose films were synonymous with spectacle—was brought in to host the show. Stars were routinely paid up to $5,000 to appear and over 50 actors, musicians and technicians were on hand every week for productions which ranged from "The Thin Man" to "The Jazz Singer" to "The African Queen."Before the show left the air in 1955, DeMille—and subsequent hosts William Keighley and Irving Cummings—welcomed nearly every major movie and radio star to the Lux microphone, including Cary Grant, Claudette Colbert, Bing Crosby, Katherine Hepburn, Humphrey Bogart, Judy Garland, Roy Rogers and Bud Abbott and Lou Costello. The Lux Radio Theater was inducted into the Radio Hall of Fame in 1989.

title: The Bonus Podcast: Creating Employees Who Think, Act, and Care Like Owners
author: Andrew Lamppa
description:
You care about your business. But do your employees?
If you’re like most small business owners, you want employees who make smart decisions, take ownership of their work, care about the results, and want to help the company succeed. But when employees are checked out, doing the bare minimum, or walking out the door, it’s easy to blame bad culture, generational differences, or the idea that nobody wants to work anymore.
What if the problem isn’t your people? What if it’s the way your business is designed to reward them?
The Bonus Podcast is the show for small business owners who want to rethink the way they pay, reward, and incentivize their employees. Hosted by Andrew Lamppa, founder of Built to Benefit, each episode explores how intentional employee bonus and incentive plans can create better performance, stronger retention, greater ownership, and a more profitable business.
Because simply handing out a surprise bonus or giving someone another raise doesn’t automatically make them care more. In fact, poorly designed incentives can backfire. Andrew believes the better approach is to create a system where employees understand what success looks like, know how they contribute to it, and share in the upside when they help create it. 
From performance bonuses and profit sharing to employee expectations, accountability, retention, and the psychology behind what actually motivates people, Andrew breaks down practical strategies for building incentive plans that work for both the business and the people helping build it.
Your employees can make more money and your business can become more profitable. They can work harder without feeling taken advantage of. And they can care about the success of the business as much as you do. Andrew specifically identified a smoother-running, more profitable company—and employees who think, act, and care like owners—as the destination of this work. 
You don’t need employees who stay because they can’t afford to leave. You need employees who stay because they’re invested in what you’re building.

description:
Stock Investing: A Practical Guide to Building Long-Term Wealth
Stock investing is one of the most accessible ways for individuals to participate in the growth of businesses and potentially build long-term wealth. When you purchase shares of a publicly traded company, you are buying a small ownership stake in that business. If the company grows, becomes more profitable, and creates greater economic value, its shares may become more valuable over time. Some companies may also distribute part of their profits to shareholders through dividends.However, stock investing is not simply about buying shares and hoping their prices increase. Successful stock investing requires an understanding of businesses, financial statements, valuation, risk, market psychology, and portfolio management. It also requires patience because stock prices can move dramatically in the short term, even when the underlying business has changed very little.For beginners, the stock market can appear complicated. Thousands of companies are available, financial news constantly changes, and investors are bombarded with predictions about which stocks will rise or fall. The reality is that investors do not need to predict every market movement to build a successful long-term strategy. Instead, they need a framework for evaluating businesses and managing their investments responsibly.

description:

Parking in someone else's space on your first morning. Sitting through a whole meeting without knowing what anything means. Reaching Christmas with zero annual leave left. Your first job comes with a lot of things nobody warns you about.

Work In Progress: an early careers podcast is a roundtable with people a few months or a few years ahead of you, talking honestly about what starting out is really like: the awkward questions, the mistakes, imposter syndrome, burnout, and what happens when your plan goes out the window.

If you're at school, college or uni and wondering what work is actually like, join us for what they don't put in the job description.


Brought to you by AECOM.

description:
Maggie, June, and Ruth stumble upon a series of perplexing incidents at Laurel Hall that challenge their friendship and courage. When strange occurrences disrupt their idyllic boarding school life by the lake, the trio finds themselves in the midst of a thrilling mystery. As they uncover clues and navigate the challenges posed by the school's elite mean girls, they must rely on their wits and teamwork to solve the puzzles around them.

This engaging adventure follows the girls as they learn new sports, forge friendships, and confront the trials of growing up in a competitive environment. Each mystery they encounter not only tests their problem-solving skills but also deepens their bond, proving that true friendship can overcome any obstacle. Whether it's a missing trophy or whispers of secret passageways, the mysteries at Laurel Hall keep listeners on the edge of their seats.

Join Maggie, June, and Ruth on their unforgettable journey filled with excitement, laughter, and life lessons. Will they unravel the secrets lurking in the school? title: One War, Many Perspectives: 1939–1945
author: Podlatino
description: One War, Many Perspectives: 1939–1945 reconstructs the Second World War through the countries that shaped, resisted, or transformed the conflict. Each episode adopts the perspective of one nation, exploring how its war began, the decisions its leaders made, the ideologies that influenced society, how civilians and soldiers experienced events, and what followed from victory, defeat, occupation, or resistance. From Nazi Germany and invaded Poland to China, Japan, the Soviet Union, the United States, and British-ruled India, the series connects events that occurred simultaneously but were understood in radically different ways. Combining historical storytelling with a documentary approach, the podcast examines alliances, propaganda, military campaigns, political choices, and everyday life without reducing history to a list of battles and dates. Designed for a general audience, the series offers listeners a clearer understanding of 1939–1945 through multiple national experiences while remaining grounded in documented facts and the immense human cost of the war.

description:
Personal growth, self-love, and inner healing are possible, even when you feel stuck, overwhelmed, or completely lost in the in-between. Whether you're navigating life transitions, struggling with people pleasing, setting boundaries, or trying to silence the negative self-talk that's been holding you back, there is a path forward. This is the space for women who are ready to do the inner work, find their purpose, and rise into the next version of themselves… one step at a time.
I'm Kimberly Rash, life coach and host of Rooted to Rise. I help women break free from self-doubt, fear of failure, and the patterns that keep them playing small, so they can step into their confidence, their calling, and their truest selves. My approach is real, honest, and rooted in faith, mindset work, and the belief that you’re not stuck.  You’re becoming.
Through the Root, Release & Rise framework, I walk women through a simple but powerful process of coming back to themselves, releasing what no longer fits, and rising boldly into who they are meant to be. Whether you're a woman over 30 reinventing yourself, navigating midlife, or simply ready to stop waiting and start moving, this podcast was made for you.
This podcast covers topics such as: 
How do I stop people pleasing and start setting boundaries? 
How do I build confidence as a woman over 30? 
How do I find my purpose when I feel lost? 
How do I practice gratitude when life feels hard? 
How do I overcome negative self-talk and start loving myself? 
How do I get out of my own way and take the next step? 
What does healing from childhood wounds look like as an adult woman? 
How do I trust my calling even when I feel unqualified? 
How do I stop self-sabotaging and start becoming who I'm meant to be? 
Where can I find a faith-based personal growth podcast for women?

title: Comparative Law Insights in  Court
author: BARR LAWSON
description:
Comparative Law Insights: Court Proceedings in Nigeria and the United Kingdom

A clear and engaging comparison of how court systems and legal proceedings work in Nigeria and the United Kingdom  from court hierarchy and criminal trials to civil litigation, juries, and legal pluralism.
 we take a detailed look at the court systems and actual court proceedings of two jurisdictions linked by a shared common-law heritage: Nigeria and the United Kingdom.
We begin by mapping the hierarchy of courts in each country  from Nigeria’s Supreme Court, Court of Appeal, Federal and State High Courts, down to Magistrate, Customary and Sharia courts, and from the UK Supreme Court through the Court of Appeal, High Court, Crown Court, County Court and Magistrates’ Courts.
We then walk through a typical criminal case in both systems, examining investigation, arraignment, trial procedure, the role of the judge versus the jury, standards of proof, sentencing and appeals. The same careful comparison is made for civil proceedings, covering how cases are commenced, the use of front-loading in Nigeria, case management tracks in England and Wales, evidence, judgment and enforcement.
Along the way we highlight the major points of contrast  legal pluralism in Nigeria, the continued use of juries in England and Wales, the structure of the legal profession, and the impact of federalism  while also noting the deep underlying similarities that still connect the two systems.
Whether you are a law student, a legal practitioner handling cross-border matters, or simply curious about how legal institutions evolve, this episode offers a clear, structured and practical overview of court proceedings in Nigeria and the United Kingdom.
